summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Cellectis S.A., a French biotech company, reporting the voting results of its Combined General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 25, 2026. The meeting covered ordinary items such as approval of financial statements, allocation of results, director renewals, share buyback authorization, capital reduction through share cancellation, amendment of board age limit, and a capital increase delegation. All resolutions were carried by large majorities, with quorum at 55.84%. No special-situation transaction—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or activist campaign—is present. The filing is a standard corporate governance update with no deal terms, breaking no new strategic event.
